title: New dinosaur fossil attraction debuts at Colchester Beach
description: The Town of Essex has launched a free Dino Dig Adventure at Colchester Beach, giving aspiring young paleontologists and their families the chance to uncover a buried dinosaur fossil in the sand.

title: New Book by Maltie Koeldiep Reveals Ancient Indian Wisdom for Modern Self-Healing
description: The Hague - July 8, 2026 - In a world where stress, anxiety and disconnection have become increasingly common, author and spiritual educator Maltie Koeldiep offers a refreshing path toward wholeness in her new book, Self-Healing Through the Eyes of the Masters: Ancient Indian Wisdom for Inner Renewal .

title: Ancient Teachings Meet Modern Wellness in Powerful New Release by Maltie Koeldiep
description: The Hague - July 8, 2026 - As millions seek alternatives to stress-driven lifestyles and fragmented approaches to health, author Maltie Koeldiep offers a compelling solution rooted in centuries of wisdom. Her newly released book, Self-Healing Through the Eyes of the Masters: Ancient Indian Wisdom for Inner Renewal, brings together the teachings of India's revered spiritual traditions into a practical guide for modern healing and self-transformation.

title: Study of ancient teeth shows leap in mammal evolution after dinosaurs
description: The global environment underwent significant transformations after the extinction of the dinosaurs, approximately 66 million years ago. Mammals took over the scene. As forests regenerated and the climate changed, mammals occupied ecosystems previously under the dominance of large reptiles, diversifying into new niches.
